title: Stargate ends in 1995 and Puharich is silenced

tellings.quote: Stargate officially ends in 95, government puts out newspaper articles all over the news, you know, Stargate there's nothing to it. It was all bunk.

plain: When Stargate, a US government program that used psychics to spy at a distance, ended in 1995, the government is said to have put out newspaper stories saying 'there's nothing to it. It was all bunk.' An unnamed researcher says this on the show, drawing on the writer Annie Jacobsen, and ties it to the silencing of Andrija Puharich, a scientist the episode connects to the CIA. In this account the press stories were a cover, hiding that the psychic work was real.
